methodology: Manual assessment against AILANG Design Axioms (docs/docs/references/axioms.mdx)

A1_determinism.name: Determinism Is a Semantic Invariant
A1_determinism.justification: Pure functional core, effects explicitly typed and capability-gated, --seed flag for deterministic randomness
evidence: No mutable state in language core

A2_replayability.name: Execution Must Be Replayable and Auditable
A2_replayability.justification: Full trace export via --emit-trace jsonl, ailang replay for trace comparison, OTEL span emission, training data export with quality scoring
evidence: --emit-trace jsonl for full execution trace export (v0.8.0 M-TRACE-EXPORT Phase 1)
ailang replay <trace.jsonl> re-executes and compares against baseline (Phase 3)
OTEL span emission with parent-child hierarchy (Phase 2)
Training data export with quality scorer (Phase 4)
Event types: function_enter/exit, effect, contract_check, budget_delta, module_start/end, error

A3_effect_legibility.name: Effects Are Real and Must Be Legible
A3_effect_legibility.justification: Full effect system with IO/FS/Clock/Net, effects declared in function signatures, --caps required
evidence: Effect system: ! IO, ! FS, ! Clock, ! Net

A4_explicit_authority.name: Authority Must Be Explicit
A4_explicit_authority.justification: Capability-based security model, no ambient authority, explicit imports
evidence: No ambient authority (can't read files without FS cap)

A5_bounded_verification.name: Verification Should Be Local, Bounded, and Automatable
A5_bounded_verification.justification: SMT-based contract verification with Z3, bounded recursive unrolling, HM type inference, pattern exhaustiveness
evidence: ailang verify: statically proves requires/ensures contracts via Z3 (v0.8.0 M-SMT-BACKEND)
Record, string, and list verification via SMT-LIB theories (M-SMT-FRAGMENT-EXPANSION)

A6_safe_concurrency.name: Concurrency Must Not Destroy Meaning
A6_safe_concurrency.justification: Sequential language core (deterministic by default), runtime concurrency via Fork() for serve-api, but no language-level concurrency primitives yet
evidence: Per-request evaluator Fork() for serve-api concurrency (v0.9.4 M-SERVE-API-CONCURRENCY)
SQLite connection pool serialization prevents lock contention (v0.9.3 M-SQLITE-CONCURRENCY)
Race-free concurrent request handling verified with go test -race
gaps: Fork() leverage across all execution modes (design_docs/planned/v0_9_5/m-concurrency-leverage.md)
Typed channel primitives (internal/channels/ reserved but empty)

A7_machines_first.name: Machines Are Primary Readers
A7_machines_first.justification: Core design principle - AI-first language with JSON schemas, M-EVAL benchmarks, teaching prompts

A8_minimal_syntax.name: Syntax Is a Liability
A8_minimal_syntax.justification: ML heritage with lambda calculus core, everything is expression, nullary calls fixed in v0.4.6
evidence: Nullary call syntax f() works (M-DX10, v0.4.6)

A9_cost_visibility.name: Cost Is Part of Meaning
A9_cost_visibility.justification: Scoped capability budgets with dual counters, budget deltas recorded in execution traces and OTEL spans
evidence: Scoped budgets: ! {IO @min=1 @limit=5} with dual counters (v0.7.0 M-DX25)
Budget delta events in execution traces (v0.8.0 M-TRACE-EXPORT)
Budget deltas as OTEL span attributes
Training data quality scorer includes budget efficiency (15% weight)
Eval harness tracks token/cost per benchmark

A10_composability.name: The Language Must Compose With Itself
A10_composability.justification: Row polymorphism, type inference composes, ADTs and pattern matching compose cleanly
evidence: Row polymorphism for extensible records and effects

A11_structured_failure.name: Failure Must Be Representable
A11_structured_failure.justification: Result ADTs with typed constructors, contract violations with source locations, error recording in execution traces
evidence: Result[a] = Ok(a) | Err(string) ADT in stdlib
Contract violations report source location and expected/actual values
JSON error schemas with position info (internal/schema/)
Error events recorded in execution traces with span status
Training data scorer weights error-free completion (30%)
Structured error composition via ADT constructors

A12_system_boundary.name: The Language Is a System Boundary
A12_system_boundary.justification: Module system with explicit imports, effect system as boundary, capability gates

highPriority.task: Leverage Fork() across all execution modes

mediumPriority.task: Implement language-level CSP with session types

history.notes: Scoped capability budgets (A9 partial->strong): ! {IO @min=1 @limit=5} with dual counters
Trace export + replay (A2 strong), SMT verification with Z3 (A5 strong)
Result ADTs + contract violations (A11 strong), per-request Fork() and SQLite concurrency fixes (A6 infrastructure)
Infrastructure release (Windows hotfix + Pi harness via M-EXEC-PI). No axiom-level changes from v0.9.2.
